common_evaluation_contract.primary_official_metric: BDDL partial goal-predicate satisfaction averaged across 100 tasks
common_evaluation_contract.selection_rule: no task, instance, checkpoint, seed, or policy unit may be selected or dropped using scientific outcomes
common_evaluation_contract.matrix_requirement: each admitted policy family must provide one frozen task-specific policy unit for every one of the 100 tasks and complete 10-instance official-evaluator outcomes when execution is later authorized

pi05_contract.training_unit: one challenge task dataset per training job; no unreviewed 100-task union training substitution
pi05_contract.batch_basis: source scripts/b1k/train_b1k.sh explicitly passes --batch_size=64 for the multi-GPU wrapper
pi05_contract.checkpoint_selection_rule: use the terminal checkpoint emitted at the frozen 50,000-step training horizon; do not select by validation or later policy outcome
pi05_contract.fresh_run_rule: new task run uses --overwrite and a unique experiment directory; resume is forbidden for confirmatory training unless a preemption-recovery receipt proves exact state continuation

data_semantics.delta_action_conversion: torso and arm groups converted through state-aligned delta mappings; grippers remain endpoint/absolute groups
data_semantics.validation_basis: val_log_interval defaults to null; B1K train loop computes validation only when explicitly enabled

checkpoint_semantics.saved_inference_params: EMA params when EMA is enabled
checkpoint_semantics.selection_rule: serve the source-emitted terminal checkpoint at step label 49999; never select an intermediate checkpoint using validation, W&B, or policy outcomes

preemption_semantics.confirmatory_default: fresh unique output directory with overwrite; no resume
preemption_semantics.recovery: resume allowed only as exact preemption recovery after a content-addressed state receipt proves optimizer/scheduler/RNG/data-loader continuity; recovery cannot alter terminal checkpoint selection

groot_contract.training_unit: one challenge task dataset per training job; no unreviewed 100-task union training substitution
groot_contract.checkpoint_selection_rule: use the terminal checkpoint emitted at the frozen 150,000-step training horizon; do not select by W&B metric, intermediate checkpoint outcome, or later policy outcome
groot_contract.fresh_run_rule: resume_from_checkpoint=false for confirmatory task training; preemption recovery requires an exact state/provenance receipt and may not change the terminal-step selection rule
groot_contract.source_precedence_note: getting_started/b1k.md at the pinned challenge fork is the challenge-specific contract; legacy/I3L sbatch examples using N1.6 or smaller batch are not the B1K 2026 training recipe

optimizer.name: adamw_torch
optimizer.library_defaults: exact Transformers optimizer defaults are inherited from the pinned dependency lock; do not substitute another AdamW implementation

data_semantics.modality: R1Pro 61-D proprioception / 23-D absolute joint action mapped by examples/b1k/r1pro.py and .json

checkpoint_semantics.final_model_save: trainer.save_model() also writes the final model to the output directory after trainer.train()
checkpoint_semantics.selection_rule: use checkpoint-150000 as the frozen scientific policy unit; do not select best-W&B/intermediate/open-loop checkpoints

preemption_semantics.recovery: exact resume is a separate preemption-recovery path only; any recovered run must preserve source state and terminal checkpoint selection and receive a content-addressed recovery receipt

full_two_family_budget_shape.note: gpu_step_units are step x GPU accounting units, not a wall-clock estimate; measured throughput preflight is required before any compute authorization
full_two_family_budget_shape.lower_bound_note: step×GPU accounting excludes data preprocessing/normalization, checkpoint I/O, model download/cache, serving startup, retries, preemption recovery, environment build, storage, and evaluation inference; it is not a wall-clock or monetary estimate

remaining_blockers: no third independent pre-outcome qualified policy family (confirmed by independent Kimi/DeepSeek review)
no complete organizer-provided 100-task checkpoint matrix; full local replication would require 200 task-specific training jobs for the two official families before adding a third family
no measured model-training throughput/cost receipt; model-load/update throughput remains deliberately deferred until the third-family and execution gates
this v2 contract requires independent review; the prior v1 reviewers both returned CONTRACT-REVISE
next_gate: independent review of this v2 source-complete contract; if qualified, only phase-0 static and phase-1 data-only preflight may proceed while third-family HOLD remains. No model load, backward, optimizer update, or policy rollout.

supersedes.reason: v1 captured headline challenge hyperparameters but omitted source-hidden optimizer/scheduler/precision/data-ordering/dependency-lock and exact terminal-save semantics; both independent reviewers requested revision before preflight-only qualification

contract_policy.source_precedence: challenge-specific B1K README/wrapper/config at the pinned revision overrides generic or legacy example scripts in the same repository; exact runtime defaults come from pinned source and dependency lock

phase_0_static: verify exact repository revisions, source file hashes, dependency-lock hashes, BEHAVIOR tag/revision, and task list digest
verify 100 task dataset manifests and R1Pro modality/action schemas without reading policy outcomes
verify base-checkpoint identifiers and access eligibility without downloading full weights when a metadata/auth check suffices
phase_1_data_only_no_model: instantiate dataset metadata/parsers and one batch-schema object without model load, optimizer, backward, or update
verify normalization-statistics path and task-local data transforms; if normalization generation has a standalone source-faithful data-only command, record its hash/output separately
measure CPU/disk decode throughput only if it requires no policy/model execution
phase_2_model_load_no_update_deferred: model-load, forward/backward, optimizer-step, or measured training throughput is not authorized by this contract and remains deferred until the third-family gate and an explicit execution/preflight authority artifact
